tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search Agent Field Kit templates, bundles and licenses by keyword. Read-only.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get one Agent Field Kit product by id. Read-only.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Create a Stripe-hosted checkout for one Agent Field Kit product and return its URL. Does NOT charge anything: a human, or an agent with explicit payment authority, must pay on the returned page. Prices: single template $29 (Agent Security Audit Kit $79), full kit of the 4 original templates $79, tea

tools.name: request_kit
tools.description: Tell Agent Field Kit which new kit you (or the person you act for) would most want to buy. Pick topics and/or describe an idea; optional price tier. Email is optional and only used to notify when a matching kit ships; include it only with that person's consent. Max 5 requests/hour.

tools.name: vote_agent_poll
tools.description: Vote in Agent Field Kit's poll 'Which AI agent platforms do you use regularly?' on behalf of the person you act for, only with their consent and with their real answer. Multi-select. Returns live results after voting. Self-selected, not a scientific sample. Max 3 votes/day per network.

tools.name: get_cyber_advisories
tools.description: Sourced cyber-defense advisories (free: headlines from the last 30 days; subscribers: full detail and history) affecting AI agent stacks (platforms, packages, frameworks, consumer bots). Read-only. Filter by date (YYYY-MM-DD) and/or component (e.g. 'litellm', 'railway', 'grok-bot', 'package:pypi/lit

tools.name: check_my_stack
tools.description: Given the components an agent runs on (frameworks, bots, platforms, packages with optional versions), return matching advisories (AFK intel plus live OSV.dev, which includes GitHub Security Advisories, for packages with an ecosystem or version), free steps first, relevant kits, and per-component cov

tools.name: get_hardening_checklist
tools.description: PREMIUM (Bearer API key). Hardening checklist for one agent stack: key rotation, connector/OAuth revocation, plugin/skill review, approval gates, logging, with config surfaces and a verification level. Independent guidance; no vendor affiliation.

tools.name: get_cyber_dashboard_data
tools.description: PREMIUM (Bearer API key). Full advisory dataset plus stack index and kit versions, for the Cyber Defense Dashboard kit to auto-update. Optional components: also returns check_my_stack results (AFK intel + live OSV.dev / GitHub advisories) and per-component coverage. Read-only; inputs are not stored.

tools.name: changes_since
tools.description: Free. What's new or updated in Agent Field Kit's cyber-defense advisories since a date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO UTC). Returns headlines plus next_since: store it and pass it on your next scheduled poll so you only fetch changes. Read-only.

tools.name: get_advisory
tools.description: Get one advisory by id. Free: headline, free first steps and sources. Subscribers (Bearer key): full detail plus a fix-it brief (patch status, fixed version, am I affected, exact steps, how to verify, matching kit). Read-only.

tools.name: search_advisories
tools.description: Keyword search over Agent Field Kit cyber-defense advisories (e.g. 'litellm', 'mcp oauth', 'railway'). Free: headlines. Subscribers: full detail and fix-it briefs. Read-only.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_hardening_checklist · Private data: check_my_stack, get_hardening_checklist, get_cyber_dashboard_data · Public sink: request_kit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_hardening_checklist · Private data: check_my_stack, get_hardening_checklist, get_cyber_dashboard_data · Public sink: request_kit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
